Hone leadership skills by leading small to medium multidisciplinary technical teams or projects, fostering collaboration and innovation. Mentor junior engineers, providing guidance in technical areas and professional development. Use creative problem solving to develop and enhance hardware and software systems. Develop firmware/HDL for embedded cyber solutions. Expand and enhance simulation and emulation environments used in laboratory experimentation. Lead hands-on experimentation, offering recommendations and technical insights. Provide hardware expertise across sponsor projects and internal research initiatives. Integrate system components with test, measurement, and analysis equipment to advance cybersecurity research and development. Qualifications You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you... Possess a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another field relevant to the duties as described above. Have 6+ years of experience developing and enhancing hardware and software for embedded systems, such as FPGAs, systems-on-a-chip (SoCs), real-time operating systems (RTOS), microcontrollers, and/or weapon systems assemblies, using supported tools and toolchains, such as Vivado Design Suite (incl. Have experience creating emulated or simulated environments based on actual systems, or developing representative emulated environments. Have knowledge of and experience applying network and system cybersecurity principles. Have experience designing electrical schematics and circuit boards using Altium or similar electronic design automation (EDA) tools. Have experience with embedded Linux workflows or Linux kernel driver development. Have experience with formal verification and testing frameworks for FPGA designs, such as Universal Verification Methodology (UVM). Have experience engineering military platforms and systems, including weapons, aircraft, spacecraft, ground vehicles, ships, submarines, combat systems, C4I, avionics, and navigation systems. Have experience with cryptographic protocols or accelerating cryptographic and other computational operations using hardware. Have experience maturing products from lower to higher Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs). Hold an active security clearance. About Us Why Work at APL? All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.
